vitals.bp_guide_device_offline_desc: Please turn on your physical measurement device and ensure it is connected to WiFi.
vitals.bp_guide_device_online: Your measurement device is connected and authorized. Press Next to continue.
vitals.bp_guide_device_went_offline: The measurement device lost connection during the session (please check system power/WiFi).
vitals.bp_guide_api_error: Failed to connect to the server during measurement: {error}
vitals.bp_guide_timeout_error:
No measurement data was received from the device within the 45-second window.

Possible Causes:
1. Improper Contact: Verify that your index finger is placed correctly on the finger sensor and chest leads are firmly attached (Step 2).
2. Device Offline: Ensure the device is powered on and connected to the WiFi network.
3. Data Submission Failure: The PPG or ECG signal quality might be poor or incomplete (minimum 8 seconds of data required), please try again.
vitals.bp_guide_step2_intro: Follow these two simple steps to set up the device correctly before starting the measurement.
vitals.bp_guide_ppg_howto_desc: Place your index fingertip inside the white clip on the device, making sure it is snug and feels a gentle, comfortable pressure.
vitals.bp_guide_ecg_howto_desc: Stick the three adhesive pads on your chest in the positions shown, then connect each colored cable to its matching pad.
vitals.bp_guide_ppg_tutorial_title: How to Place the Finger Sensor
vitals.bp_guide_ppg_tutorial_step1: Hold the finger clip steady with one hand.
vitals.bp_guide_ppg_tutorial_step2: Gently slide your index finger all the way into the clip.
vitals.bp_guide_ppg_tutorial_step3: Keep a light, comfortable pressure — don't squeeze the clip.
vitals.bp_guide_ppg_tutorial_step4: Hold your hand still until the light on the clip stays on.
vitals.bp_guide_ecg_tutorial_title: How to Place the Chest Pads
vitals.bp_guide_ecg_dot_red: Red pad: upper right side of your chest, just below the collarbone.
vitals.bp_guide_ecg_dot_yellow: Yellow pad: upper left side of your chest, just below the collarbone.
vitals.bp_guide_ecg_dot_green: Green pad: lower right side of your torso, below the ribs.
vitals.bp_guide_ecg_tutorial_step1: Clean and dry the skin at each spot shown above before sticking a pad.
vitals.bp_guide_ecg_tutorial_step2: Stick the three pads on your chest and torso at the positions shown.
vitals.bp_guide_ecg_tutorial_step3: Connect each colored cable from the device to the matching colored pad.
vitals.bp_guide_ecg_tutorial_step4: Stay relaxed and avoid moving your chest during the measurement.
vitals.bp_guide_all_connected: Connected successfully! You can press Next now.
vitals.bp_guide_next_disabled_device: Waiting for the device to come online before you can continue.
vitals.bp_guide_next_disabled_sensors: Connect both the finger sensor and the chest sensor before you can continue.
vitals.bp_guide_regular_result_desc: Your blood pressure reading has been saved. No further steps are needed.
vitals.bp_guide_calibration_banner: One-time calibration: enter your cuff reading so future measurements from the device stay accurate.
vitals.bp_guide_rejection_finger_missing: We couldn't detect your finger on the sensor. Place your fingertip flat over the sensor window and try again.
vitals.bp_guide_rejection_leads_off: The chest electrodes don't seem to be attached. Press all three electrode pads firmly onto your skin and try again.
vitals.bp_guide_rejection_poor_signal: The signal was too weak to measure reliably. Sit still, keep your hand relaxed, and try again.
vitals.bp_guide_rejection_out_of_range: The reading was outside the expected range. Rest for a minute, make sure the sensors are placed correctly, and try again.
vitals.bp_guide_rejection_unknown: The measurement couldn't be completed. Check that the sensors are placed correctly and try again.
vitals.bp_guide_live_finger_lost: Finger not detected! Place your fingertip back on the sensor now or the measurement will fail.
vitals.bp_guide_live_leads_lost: Chest electrodes disconnected! Press the pads back onto your skin now or the measurement will fail.
vitals.bp_guide_estimated_note: Estimated from your calibrated device reading
vitals.signal_poor_badge: Poor signal — reposition your finger and consider remeasuring
vitals.spo2_no_data: No reading yet — take a measurement
